sentence: This project builds a network of researchers assessing the sustainability of materials and their impacts on the environment and human health.
This project studies how to measure different causes of uncertainty and use them to solve decision-making problems more effectively.
This project improves the sensitivity of a chemical analysis technique that works in very low magnetic fields.
This project studies ion transport in the confined pores of porous materials using computer simulations and spectroscopic measurements.
This project builds tools to sequence, visualize and analyze glycoRNAs, which combine the properties of RNA and glycans, in plants, yeast and bacteria.
This project builds tools to model and analyze the energy use and timing of software for systems that harvest energy from their environment.
This project tries to find out what makes up a bubble nucleus in tissues and how minerals deposited in tissues change bubble nuclei.
This project seeks to increase awareness of the technology fields of Advanced Networking, Cybersecurity, and the Internet of Things.
This project builds synthetic communities of anaerobic fungi and bacteria that turn plant waste into volatile fatty acids.
This project studies how biomimetic design in 3D-printed prosthetics, materials and anatomical models affects their structure-function relationships.
This project develops artificial intelligence that uses acoustic signals to find defects during quality inspection in harsh industrial settings.
This project builds a framework that explains how a product's design features constrain its disassembly.
This project studies how the life cycle of a widespread seaweed is linked to its reproduction, using common garden experiments and DNA analysis.
This project studies how Klebsiella pneumoniae from the environment interact with host defense systems and evolve antimicrobial resistance.
This project studies how experienced engineering designers incorporate the physical, social and economic environment of a technology into design decisions.
This project builds software infrastructure for high-performance distributed sparse tensor computations, especially in quantum chemistry and machine learning.
